title: ERP · Unified clinical workspace
brief: Self-contained Spanish staff ERP demo for fictional Clínica Dental Andina; no backend, credentials, external calls or persistence. T7/S31–S36/S38–S39 implemented, current runtime GREEN and fresh independent verification pending. T8/S37 structured disease/medicine documentation, indications/recommendations and clinical text actions remain pending; no complete S1–S39 claim. Paid orders retain detail/receipts without payment/QR launchers or no-balance filler. Patients have editable unique identity documents distinct from immutable link IDs; new PAT-* IDs allocate only after shared validation. Fictional fixture documents 900001/900002/900003 preserve existing history/appointment/order links. Tables have actual typed columns, not generic Configuration: specialties name, rooms name/location/status, physicians name/document/specialties/availability, services name/price, descriptive catalogs name/description. Laboratorio/Imagenología have only descriptive fields, implicit fixed modality, no price or tariff mapping; requests/results remain clinical and free, never billing lines. Only explicitly selected Servicios / Aranceles a cobrar in Atención clínica become PROCEDIMIENTO order snapshots, paid in Cobros. Medicamentos replaces the obsolete Triage menu/state/route/role key with independent name/description CRUD, fictional seed, unique capsule SVG and future optional-array consultation-reference deletion protection; inventory is not reused and no prescribing UI is introduced. Existing S29/S30 Navigation target-role selector, atomic unified save, separate global visibility/order and 8px icon gaps are preserved. All seventeen menu SVGs remain distinct with 44px action targets, hover/focus tooltips, upper-right Agregar + and readable modal/Configuration controls. Per-menu Acceder grants and central crosslink guards remain strict, intersecting personal/global visibility; only Administrator initially receives the new medicine menu. Separate finance/agenda/clinical Resumen grants and role-ID-bound allowed-only hide/order preferences remain. Fictional data in the downloaded HTML is not protected by this demo visibility model. Financial baseline 700/250/450/1400, outgoing Pagos ledger, appointment lifecycle, human clinical context, exact-cent selected-service billing, non-payable QR/cash idempotence and receipt snapshots are preserved in regression tests. Simulated no-credential login/logout reloads and resets all state. Parent observed actual T7 HTTP RED job1 exit1/12s/49 passing checks. Historical S29/S30 author HTTP1991/22 own HTML loads/no violations and earlier S27/S28 independent60 are not current-candidate verification. Screenshots await parent-owned refresh; no native approval or production medical/payment/security readiness is claimed. T7 author runtime passed HTTP2128/24 owned HTML loads/zero external/API/storage writes and page errors, screenshots refreshed. T8 structured clinical fields and final independent verification remain pending.

artboards.title: Unified business workspace
artboards.tradeoff: One preserved sourced-light shell with connected master CRUD, patient identity documents and stable internal links, free descriptive studies, priced selected services, independent medicine references and no obsolete Triage. S29/S30 Navigation and icon spacing remain intact. Explicit role/menu/content simulation is not backend authorization. Appointment → consultation → free study requests/results → selected-service order → cash/non-payable QR → immutable DEMO receipts remains the intended regression path. The exact-cent 600.30 journey selects actual 300/100.10/200.20 services; it never charges studies. T7 implementation and static verification only; parent-owned runtime GREEN, new independent proof, persistent-URL acceptance and screenshot refresh are pending. Historical author1991 and prior independent60 do not approve this material candidate. T8 structured diagnoses/prescriptions/recommendations and clinical text actions are intentionally not implemented. No real clinical care, payment, authentication, backend, storage or publication.
